title: Thuyamyint
descriptionAboutMe: I build and operate end-to-end software systems, from frontend and backend to infrastructure and deployment. My focus is on scalable architecture, CI/CD automation, and reliable production systems.
stack: Next.js · Go · Node.js · AWS · CI/CD · Infrastructure · React Native
stackReact: I build web apps with Next.js and mobile apps with React Native, focusing on performance, scalability, and clean architecture using SSR, TanStack Query, and Tailwind CSS.
stackBackend: I design maintainable backend services using Node.js and Go, with clear domain boundaries, stateless APIs, and explicit validation and error handling.
stackData: I work with document and relational databases and Redis, designing schemas and indexes based on access patterns to ensure performance and reliability.
stackInfra: I manage cloud infrastructure with containerization and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring consistent, repeatable deployments across environments.
stackMicroservices: I design microservice architectures with independent services, Docker-based deployment, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging to ensure scalability and fault isolation.
systemArchitectureDescription: The system follows a layered, service-oriented architecture with a Next.js frontend, API gateway, independent backend services, dedicated data stores, and automated cloud deployments via CI/CD.
workExperiencesDescription: Companies I've worked with and contributed to.
nexaCoreDescription: Developing full-stack applications using modern technologies. Building scalable web applications and contributing to infrastructure improvements.
aboutNexaCore: Nexa Core was an IT solutions company delivering web and mobile apps using the MERN stack and React Native for scalable, high-performance, cross-platform solutions
curioLmsDescription: Curio LMS is a multi-role, multi-school, and multi-course learning management system designed for scalable education platforms.
curioLmsDetail: It supports students, teachers, and school administrators with strict access control. Students can access teaching materials only after enrollment, and access is automatically revoked when the course duration ends. Teachers can manage courses across multiple platforms, while email notifications are sent for enrollments, approvals, and status changes.
shomynDescription: Shomyn Horizon is a multi-shop e-commerce platform with a real-time order management dashboard.
shomynDetail: It supports multiple roles using middleware-based role control and JWT authentication to ensure data integrity. Redis is used for caching and performance optimization, while Socket.IO enables real-time order updates across shops.
shiftlyJpDescription: Shiftly JP is a shift-tracking application built to manage part-time work in Japan.
shiftlyJpDetail: It was developed to track working hours while studying at a language school in Japan. The system supports OAuth authentication, multiple themes, and bilingual support (English and Japanese), focusing on usability for foreign part-time workers.
cloudPathDescription: A weather and map visualization application built with React.
cloudPathDetail: A React-based application that combines a weather API and a map API. Location search resolves geographic coordinates, updates map navigation, and fetches real-time weather data for the selected area.
footerDescription: Full-Stack Developer building performant interfaces, resilient backends, and infrastructure that scales without excuses.
directResNoSpam: Direct contact. No spam. Response within 24 hours.
journey_pursuit: The craft of engineering is a lifelong pursuit. Currently building the future in Japan.
journey_looking_problems: I am always looking for complex problems to solve and innovative teams to join.
journey_hero_description: A systematic documentation of my evolution from a curious beginner to a cloud-native architect.
journey_2021_desc: My journey in computer science began in 2021, driven by a strong and genuine fascination with how systems work and how software is built from first principles.

journey_2022_detail: Strengthened logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Began studying Japanese with a long-term goal of working in a Japanese technical environment.
journey_2023_desc: Entered the ITPEC certification track and prepared for the Information Technology Passport (IP) exam.
journey_2023_detail: Continued studying algorithms in C++ and strengthened understanding of systems architecture, networking, and security. Successfully passed the IP examination.
journey_2024_desc: Advanced to the ITPEC Fundamental Engineer (FE) level. Deepened algorithmic knowledge and expanded into web development.
journey_2024_detail: Built desktop applications using Java GUI. Learned HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP. Passed JLPT N2 and the ITPEC FE examination in October 2024.
journey_2024_2025_desc: Worked as a Full-Stack Developer at NexaCore IT Solution in Myanmar, contributing to real production systems.
journey_2024_2025_detail: Developed frontend and backend using React, React Native, Redux, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Gained hands-on experience with GCP deployment and operations.

journey_2025_present_detail: Shifted focus toward modern, scalable, cloud-native architectures. Mastering Next.js, Go, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
